title: Spectral Radius Conditions for 3-Uniform Intersecting Families
summary: Let $M_k$ denote a matching of size $k$. The classical Erdős matching conjecture asks for the maximum number of edges of an intersecting $r$-graph without $M_k$. The csae for $k=2$, which is known as intersecting $r$-graph, is established by Erdős, Ko and Rado. Hilton and Milner further determine the maximum number of edges of a non-trivial intersecting $r$-graph, where the intersecting $r$-graph $H$ is called non-trivial if $\cap_{e\in E(H)}e=\emptyset$.
